app.title: Dota 2 Highlight Recorder
list.title: Local replays
list.empty: No local replays yet. Enter a match ID above to download one, or download it in game under Watch → Match History.
match.title: Match {id}
match.noClips: This player has no kills in the match, so there is nothing to record.
match.summary: {n} of {total} clips selected · {secs} of video · about {minutes} min to record
rec.confirm.title: Start recording
rec.confirm.what: Record {n} clips, {secs} of video, about {minutes} min (not counting the game start).
rec.ask.title: Please confirm
rec.title: Recording
ev.waitQuit: Dota is running normally; recording needs it restarted with the console port. Please quit Dota (main menu → Exit); recording continues once it has closed.
ev.restoringSize: Quitting the game to put the window size back to {w}×{h}…
ev.sizeNotRestored: Couldn't put the window size back ({error}); set it to {w}×{h} in the game's video settings
ev.diag: Console log for troubleshooting is in {dir}
rules.title: Clip rules (advanced)
rules.anchor: Fight start is based on damage between
rules.maxLead: Start at most this long before the kill (s)
rules.keepGap: Keep idle gaps inside a clip up to (s)
settings.title: Settings
settings.compile.hint: Also join all clips into one video
settings.quitAfter.hint: Only when every clip is done; after a stop the game stays open so you can resume
settings.ffmpeg.hint: ffmpeg.exe or its folder. Leave empty to search the program folder, the D2HR_FFMPEG variable and PATH.
rec.result.gameOpen: The game is still open in recording mode (no matchmaking). Quit it from the top right when you're done.
rec.result.gameKept: Dota is kept open, so resuming doesn't need a restart.
rec.paused.title: Paused
rec.paused.what: You did something inside Dota, so the recording paused and the interrupted part is discarded. Resume sets the camera again, puts the game back behind your windows and re-records that part.
ev.paused: Paused; waiting for Resume or Stop
ev.resuming: Resuming: setting the camera again and re-recording the interrupted part…
home.downloading: Downloading match {id}… (if OpenDota doesn't have the replay address yet, it has to fetch it first, up to 2 minutes)
home.badId: A match ID is a number
match.overwrite: , {n} of them will overwrite existing videos
match.recordedHint: The output folder already has a video of this clip; recording again overwrites it
match.preselectMissing: {n} unfinished clip(s) don't match the current rules (rules changed?). Please tick them yourself.
rec.confirm.overwrite: {n} of these clips were recorded before and will be overwritten.
videos.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Pick a match under Matches, tick some clips and start recording.
videos.delete.title: Delete records of match {id}
videos.delete.what: Removes all recording records of this match from Recorded.
videos.delete.files: Also delete the video files (move to Recycle Bin)
videos.noRecord: No recording records for this match.
home.where: Replays live in Dota 2's replays folder, the same place the game's Download button saves to. For a match you don't have, enter its ID and the app gets the replay address from OpenDota and downloads it.
home.err.noMatch: Match {id} not found: OpenDota doesn't know this match. Is the ID right?
home.err.noUrl: OpenDota still couldn't get the replay address after 2 minutes. You can download it in game under Watch → Match History.
home.err.expired: The replay has expired: Valve's server no longer has it.
home.delete.title: Delete the replay of match {id}
home.delete.what: The replay files go to the Recycle Bin, so Dota 2 won't list them either. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.
home.delete.keep: Videos already recorded and the recording history are not affected.
home.deleted: Moved the replay of match {id} to the Recycle Bin.
home.deletedMany: Moved {n} replays to the Recycle Bin.
rec.confirm.pause: Clicking or typing inside Dota pauses the recording; you can then resume or stop. Clips already recorded are kept.
rec.confirm.restart1080: Dota will start at 1920×1080 (with a console port, no matchmaking), quit when done, and your display settings will be put back. Changed game settings are restored too.
rec.confirm.restartNative: Dota will be started if needed (with a console port, no matchmaking; quit and restart it from Steam afterwards). Changed game settings are restored when done.
rec.stopping: {reason}, stopping and restoring the game settings…
match.camera.hint: Hero chase: the hero stays in the middle. Player view: the player's own camera at the time, following where they looked.
settings.capture.hint: 1080p records about twice as fast as 2560×1600: the game restarts at 1080p, quits when done and your display settings are put back.
rec.confirm.window: Dota pops up briefly at the start of each part; the app puts it back behind your other windows right away. You can use other programs meanwhile, but don't operate the Dota window.
rec.window: Recording: Dota pops up briefly at the start of each part and the app puts it back. You can use other programs, but don't operate Dota; clicking or typing in it pauses the recording.
